changes: Dependency isolation and removal of unused branches; scientific kernels retained.
intentional_differences: Standalone background training replaces reading a frozen parent; the same numerical stage and mapping selection rules are retained, including rejection when training and inference checkpoints differ.
Original defaults restored to 20 fits and 300 epochs with background-matched initialization and learned fraction; configuration is now explicit YAML.
Prepared NPY arrays replace the Parquet intermediate without changing feature expressions, partition membership or row ordering.
Local flow classes replace upstream global class registration without changing forward calculations or weights.
Compact flat riddle source layout, manifests, strict resume contracts, output schema and plotting interface replace legacy framework dependencies.
Optional shifted and DeltaR preparations follow the pinned LaCathode preparation definitions; default inputs remain unchanged. DeltaR uses a five-dimensional residual model only when selected.
